notes: Template: ABox expansion of a fictional subject (a made-up town in a real state, relation located_in). No original answers, no related queries, no derivability. The three derived questions connect the new town to real knowledge in exactly 2 hops, each through one bridge the model holds (checked before editing): its country by transitivity of located_in, and two compositions that follow the edit to the state and look up a stored fact about Queensland (its capital, the reef off its coast). The state was chosen so that the edit decides the answers: the first version put the town in Colorado, but an English-sounding town name asked about in English points to the United States as the default guess, so a right country answer could come from a prior rather than transitivity. Australia is not that default, so 'Australia' needs the edit and the bridge. The name was chosen to be neutral: a Norwegian- or Hawaiian-sounding name would give away the country or state without the edit. The question wording never names Australia, so the country question is not answered by the edit prompt itself. A time-zone question was dropped: asked of the town ('In which time zone is Callowridge?') it needs located_in ∘ in_time_zone ⊑ in_time_zone, which in_time_zone does not have in RELATIONS.md; the reef question is a composition about the state instead. An application question would need that same property, so both remaining questions are compositions. Unrelated near: Wikipedia's Queensland lead gives one southern neighbour ('bordered by the Northern Territory, South Australia and New South Wales to the west, south-west and south, respectively').
